name: war gauntlets
_design_note: F50-100 heavy hand slot. Articulated fingers + knuckle plate. Pairs with plate / full plate body.
lore_template: Every finger of these {material_name} war gauntlets is jointed by itself, and a ridge of plate crosses the knuckles. They spread a hammer blow over the whole hand, and smiths covet them besides for the humbler labors of the forge.
